'''Grandfather''' was the name of an aggressive giant [[bormu]] living on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] in the year [[3643 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Grandfather appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion world boss on Balmorra. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
